Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €374.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Extending the payment term to 90 days would necessitate a price increase to offset financing costs, so we must insist on maintaining the 30-day term. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

To demonstrate our commitment to this partnership, we can offer a revised price of €370.50 under the standard 30-day payment terms, with standard terms of a price of €370.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We acknowledge your revised offer; however, the minor adjustment does not bridge the significant gap to our cost realities. In accordance with our corporate guidelines, we can reduce our price to €374.20 per unit while accommodating your request for a 90-day payment term. 

Consequently, our offer comprises a price of €374.20 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your revised offer, but the minor adjustment remains insufficient to cover the substantial increases in our raw material costs. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

In the interest of progressing our negotiations, we are prepared to lower our price slightly to €373.85 per unit for the requested 90-day payment term. Thus, our current Angebot comprises a price of €373.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We expect a more significant movement from your side in the next round to reach a mutually viable agreement.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We acknowledge your revised offer, but the gap to our cost realities remains substantial. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We expect a more significant step from your side to reach an agreement. Nevertheless, we are prepared to make a further concession to €373.64 for the requested 90-day payment term. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our parameters are a price of €373.64 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
